in_hebrew.name: Yankee
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו A native or inhabitant of a country
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Yankee הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Dutch word 'jannekin', meaning 'Johnkin'. Originally used to describe Dutch settlers in America, later extended to include all inhabitants of the United States. The term carries connotations of patriotism and loyalty to the country.

biblical_reference.note: The term 'Yankee' is of English origin and was used to refer to Americans, specifically those from New England during the American Revolution. It is derived from 'Johnny' or 'Jon' and the Dutch word 'Jan' or 'Hans', which were common names in New England at the time. There is no biblical reference for this name.
